summary: Iteration 31 — comprehensive E2E + UI polish audit on Bracket. Verified backend guards (shared-freeze 409s on /unlock and /reset-from-step), auth (password + OTP dev_code flow), dashboard stage tags + all 6 filter pills, shared project overview (Unlock/edit hidden + hint visible), client review /r/{token} accept modal (fits 1366x768, inputs aligned, checklist 3-column) and reject flow (modal centered with textarea + Bracket suggestions CTA), landing page at 1920 and 1366 (no horizontal scroll, 5 showcase cards with 0 trailing gap, 14 bento SVGs, section bg all transparent — no seams). All CRITICAL functional flows working. Several polish issues found (loader duration 4.3s vs 3s target, checklist bottom row clipped by fixed footer at 1366×768, terminology inconsistency between dashboard tag and overview badge, missing/nonstandard data-testids on landing arrows + review-reject-modal, noisy 401s on /api/auth/me for anonymous visitors).

minor.issue: Anonymous frontend visits get 6+ 401 responses per session (Landing, /login, /r/{token}). Anonymous-safe endpoints (landing, public share) should not gate on auth or should suppress the 401 log by returning 200 with user:null. Fills the browser console with red errors.

ui_bugs.issue: At 1366×768, last row of checklist items ('retail launch flexibility', etc. — the 20th/21st items) is clipped beneath the fixed .review-accept-footer bar. inner_scroll reports overflow_px=0 (panel fits) but the checklist itself has more items than can be viewed above the footer. On larger viewports all 21 items are visible.
Loader stays attached ~4.3s on hard load (measured 0.48s attach → 4.31s detach). Task spec + iteration-30 report both said target is ~3s. Extra ~1.3s adds friction on every page navigation.

Both share_status='sent' (client hasn't reviewed yet) and share_status='awaiting_reply' (owner replied after rejection) collapse to the SAME 'AWAITING REPLY' amber tag. The Overview page distinguishes them ('AWAITING CLIENT REVIEW' badge vs no such badge). Consider a distinct label like 'SENT' or 'IN REVIEW' for the sent state to give the owner clarity.

issues: No data-testid on showcase arrows — spec expected [data-testid='showcase-arrow-left'/'-right']. The arrows do render as visible overlay controls per the earlier screenshot; only missing test hooks. Adding testids will unblock automated arrow-edge-hide verification.

Modal wrapper is a bare [role='dialog'] with class .review-modal-overlay + .review-modal-panel — no [data-testid='review-reject-modal']. Adding a data-testid on the wrapper (accept + reject variants) will make automated coverage of the reject flow reliable.

7 bento cards described in spec have no data-testid^='bento-' attributes on the card wrappers. 14 SVGs present (illustrations + icons), no tags → visualisations are all SVG as intended. Only the testability is missing.
4.3s duration feels a hair long on repeat navigations. Consider reducing to 2.4-3s or skipping after first paint for same-session route changes.

Checklist rendered in 3 columns. 24 inputs total (21 checkboxes + Name/Role/Email at y=679.75 aligned in one row). inner_scroll overflow_px=0. Issue: last 1-2 checklist items are visually clipped by the fixed sign-off footer at 1366×768.
Opens centered, textarea + 'Back to document' + 'See Bracket suggestions' CTAs visible, no clipping.
landing-hero, -showcase, -bento, -story, -testimonials, -pricing, -final-cta all present. All section backgrounds rgba(0,0,0,0) with 0px borders → no visible seams between sections.
5 cards (620px each), scrollWidth 3282, at scrollLeft=max the trailing_gap = 0 → no blank space after 5th card.
14 SVGs (illustrations + icons, roughly 2 per card × 7 cards), 0 tags → all SVG visualisations as required.

Cannot open on the seed data — Ceramic Vase project is in share_status='sent' state so [data-testid='overview-view-review-cta'] is not rendered. Modal is only shown when share_status='rejected'. Iteration-30 already verified the modal layout (1080px 2-col grid, centered) so re-verify is only needed if a rejected project is re-seeded.

action_items: MEDIUM: Fix Accept modal on 1366×768 — either reduce checklist row spacing, tighten the fixed footer, or move footer above modal edge so last 1-2 acceptance items don't clip beneath the .review-accept-footer.
LOW: Reduce PageLoader duration from 4.3s to ~2.5-3s to hit the stated target.

LOW: Split 'AWAITING REPLY' dashboard tag into two states — one for share_status='sent' (e.g. 'IN REVIEW') and one for 'awaiting_reply' — to match the overview badge wording and give the owner clearer signal.
LOW/TESTABILITY: Add data-testid attributes to landing showcase arrows (showcase-arrow-left/right), bento cards (bento-{key}), and client review modals (review-accept-modal, review-reject-modal).

LOW: Suppress or gracefully handle /api/auth/me 401 for anonymous visitors — either treat as expected (no console.error) or wrap in try/catch that logs at debug level instead of surfacing 6+ red console errors on every anonymous navigation.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx line 139-140 — projectStage() collapses two distinct backend states ('sent' + 'awaiting_reply') into a single UI label 'AWAITING REPLY'. The two states have different semantics: 'sent' = client hasn't opened, 'awaiting_reply' = owner replied and now client owes a response. Consider two labels for owner clarity.

ClientReview.jsx AcceptForm — the 21-item .review-accept-checklist is rendered inside a modal panel with a fixed .review-accept-footer. At 1366×768 the checklist items exceed the vertical space above the footer, and the footer overlays the last row (I saw 'retail launch flexibility' partially cut off). Options: (a) reduce vertical row-gap, (b) add scrollable interior for the checklist region only (leaving the footer static), (c) drop the least-critical acceptance items.
PageLoader.jsx — measured detach at 4.31s but comment in code + iteration-30 say '3s duration'. Verify the actual setTimeout / animation duration matches the documented 3s target.

Auth cross-cutting — every route change fires /api/auth/me even when the visitor is on a public route (Landing, /r/{token}). This is a wasted round-trip for anonymous visitors AND generates noisy 401 console errors. Consider gating the /me call behind a session-cookie presence check or making /api/auth/me return 200 { user: null } for anonymous.
Testability — Landing showcase arrows, bento cards, and both client review modal variants lack data-testids. Not functional bugs but they undermine automated regression coverage.

rca_of_the_issue: Accept modal checklist clipping (1366×768): The AcceptForm renders 21 checklist items in a 3-column grid inside a modal panel whose max-height is capped at ~744px. A fixed footer bar with signature inputs is positioned at the bottom of the panel. On 1366×768 the checklist grid needs ~640px of vertical space; the footer bar consumes ~90px; combined they exceed the 720px content region, so the bottom row of the checklist ('assumptions: 11-week timeline is non-negotiable...') is rendered underneath the footer overlay. Fix candidates: give .review-accept-checklist its own overflow-y:auto (isolated inner scroll like the reject flow uses), or reduce checklist row-gap from ~20px to 12px, or bump the modal panel max-height to min(90vh, 860px) so more room is available.
